events.title: The NEW match engine is LIVE!!
events.summary: The new match is now live in the new Demo Update I rebuilt the matchday engine. Goals now are decided in live situations in which you are forced to choose what to do organically instead of being given three options from premade situations. A new clock Minutes with nothing happening go by fast. Chances for both teams play out in real time. When you have a decision to make, the clock stops and waits for you. events.title: DEMO 1.3 LIVE!
events.summary: Matches The pitch now anticipates goals: the move is built over the preceding seconds instead of being resolved the instant the goal happens. Goal animations start from the ball's actual position. Player movement: individual top speeds, a distinction between jogging and sprinting, a cost for changing direction, and the effect of fatigue late in the match.
